method: Read from the publishers' own pages in a browser on the capture date and written to these files by script, without retyping. See docs/sources.md.

holdings_nbpe.csv / snapshots_nbpe.csv.publisher: NB Private Equity Partners Limited, monthly NAV announcements
holdings_nbpe.csv / snapshots_nbpe.csv.archive: FCA National Storage Mechanism, https://data.fca.org.uk (each snapshot's own URL is in snapshots_nbpe.csv)
holdings_nbpe.csv / snapshots_nbpe.csv.coverage: 55 monthly reports, 2022-02-28 to 2026-08-31, top-30 holdings table each
holdings_nbpe.csv / snapshots_nbpe.csv.tie_out: 52 of 55 tables sum to the publisher's own total row within 0.5; 2023-03-31, 2023-04-30 and 2023-08-31 do not (reported as findings Q01/Q02, not corrected)

track_record_calpers.csv.publisher: CalPERS, Private Equity Program Fund Performance Review

tie_out.note: column sums computed on the live page at capture; tests/test_sample_data.py checks the file against them

prices.csv.coverage: month-end closes from 2021-08-31 plus the last 25 trading days to 2026-10-06, for XLK XLF XLI XLY XLV XLC IYT SPY NBPE.L
prices.csv.note: a thinned sample for offline runs; `navmon refresh` fetches full daily history

rates.csv.publisher: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis: SOFR and IUDSOIA (SONIA)
rates.csv.coverage: month-end values from 2021-08-31 plus the last 10 observations

corrections.change: 2023-09-30 row 'Business Services Company4' -> 'Business Services Company'. The '4' was a superscript footnote mark that the browser capture read as part of the name. Found by `navmon verify-live` on its first live run; the live parser had it right.
